task: A record has a structured JATS/XML fulltext pointer and a separate PDF URL from a different source.
A record's access.is_oa is True and best_url is set, but the version field is null (no version-of-record/accepted-manuscript info).
A record has no OA location anywhere but does have an abstract.
A record's access.is_oa is explicitly False and it has no abstract.
A record has is_oa=None (unknown) and no version entries at all.
A record has neither title nor any access signal.
Resolve OA access for a record whose only OA location is a publisher landing page with no direct PDF or fulltext link.
An OA location exists but requires the resolver to guess/construct a PDF URL pattern that wasn't actually returned by any adapter.
Determine retrieval depth reached for a record resolved to OA_PDF_AVAILABLE and readable=True.
Determine retrieval depth reached for a record resolved to METADATA_ONLY with no abstract.
A corpus acquisition request specifies LEVEL_1_ABSTRACT depth; a candidate record only reaches LEVEL_0_METADATA.
PMC's legacy OA Web Service is unavailable (decommissioned); determine PMCID open-access status.
